Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO) filed a lawsuit in U.S. District Court in New Jersey against Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) on July 21, accusing its primary rival of false advertising and unfair competition regarding television and digital campaigns […]
